description: Scrape the US government clinical-trial registry (ClinicalTrials.gov v2 REST API). Search by free-text, condition, intervention, location, sponsor, or look up by NCT ID. Filter by status, phase, study type, demographic eligibility, country, and date ranges.

ageGroups.description: Restrict to studies enrolling one or more age groups. Empty = no filter.
ageGroups.title: Age groups

completionDateFrom.description: Drop studies whose completion date is before this date.
completionDateFrom.title: Completion date — from (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

completionDateTo.description: Drop studies whose completion date is after this date.
completionDateTo.title: Completion date — to (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

conditionQuery.description: Disease, condition, or medical term (e.g. `diabetes`, `breast cancer`, `Alzheimer disease`).
conditionQuery.title: Condition / disease (mode=byCondition)

containsKeyword.description: Client-side filter: keep only records whose title, summary, eligibility, conditions, keywords, or interventions contain this substring (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

country.description: Restrict to studies with a trial location in a specific country (matches `protocolSection.contactsLocationsModule.locations[].country`).
country.title: Country

hasResults.description: When enabled, only emit studies that have results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. When disabled (default), all studies are returned regardless of results status.
hasResults.title: Only studies with posted results

interventionQuery.description: Drug name, device, biological, or therapy (e.g. `metformin`, `pembrolizumab`, `CAR-T`).
interventionQuery.title: Intervention / drug (mode=byIntervention)

locationQuery.description: Geographic location text (city, state, country) — e.g. `Boston`, `California`, `United States`.
locationQuery.title: Location (mode=byLocation)

nctIds.description: List of NCT identifiers like `NCT04280705`. Full URLs (`https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT...`) are also accepted.
nctIds.title: NCT IDs (mode=byNctIds)

phases.description: Restrict to one or more trial phases. Empty array = no filter.
phases.title: Phases

searchQuery.description: Free-text query against the full study record. Used by mode=search; also serves as a fallback for the other browse modes if their specific query is empty.
searchQuery.title: Search query (mode=search)

sex.description: Restrict to studies enrolling a specific sex. `ALL` matches studies open to any sex.
sex.title: Eligible sex

sponsorQuery.description: Lead sponsor / organization name (e.g. `Pfizer`, `Mayo Clinic`, `NIH`). Use the exact registered lead-sponsor name as it appears on ClinicalTrials.gov — for example, `ModernaTX` (not `Moderna`), `Pfizer Inc.` (not `Pfizer`). Partial names may return 0 results — use the CT.gov website search to identify the exact registered name first.
sponsorQuery.title: Lead sponsor (mode=bySponsor)

startDateFrom.description: Drop studies that started before this date. ISO 8601 partial dates accepted (e.g. `2020`, `2020-01`, `2020-01-15`).
startDateFrom.title: Start date — from (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

startDateTo.description: Drop studies that started after this date.
startDateTo.title: Start date — to (YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD)

status.description: Restrict to a single recruitment / overall status. Leave empty for no filter.
status.title: Overall status

studyType.description: Restrict to a study type. Leave empty for no filter.
studyType.title: Study type

title: ClinicalTrialsGov Scraper Input
